module.tpp.description: Quantities from suppliers to customers at minimal cost
field.supply.help: Quantity the supplier delivers at most. If the total supply does not cover the demand, it delivers exactly this quantity.
field.supply.help.network: Quantity the supplier puts into the network. With balance “automatic” a remainder stays if the supply is larger than the demand.
field.minSupply.help: Lower bound of the range: the supplier delivers at least this much. Empty: 0.
field.maxSupply.help: Upper bound of the range: the supplier delivers at most this much. Empty: the supply.
field.maxSupply.help.maxflow: This supplier puts at most this much into the network. Empty: unlimited.
field.demand.help: Quantity that reaches the customer. If the total supply is not enough, it is distributed completely and part of the demand stays open.
field.demand.help.network: Quantity that should reach the customer. With balance “automatic” part of it may be missing if the supply is not enough – it costs the shortage costs.
field.demand.help.location: Demand of the customer – determines the transport costs and, with capacities, the utilisation of the locations. Empty: 1.
field.demand.help.vrp: Quantity brought to the customer. It must fit into one vehicle. A customer is served by exactly one tour.
field.minDemand.help: Lower bound of the range: the customer receives at least this much. Empty: 0.
field.maxDemand.help: Upper bound of the range: the customer receives at most this much. Empty: the demand.
field.maxDemand.help.maxflow: This customer takes at most this much out of the network. Empty: unlimited.
field.costFactor.help: The transport costs to this customer are multiplied by it, e.g. 1.2 for a surcharge. Empty: 1.
field.objSense.help: Minimal costs, maximal contribution (with prices and unit costs), the largest quantity transported or the smallest highest cost rate (bottleneck).
field.matrixMode.help: Not set: costs if cost per km or per hour are set, otherwise distances
field.isSingleSource: Each customer from exactly one supplier
field.isSingleSource.help: Every customer is supplied completely by a single supplier, its demand is not split.
field.useSupplyRanges.help: Instead of a fixed supply a range from the minimum to the maximum supply – the solver chooses the quantity within it.
field.useDemandRanges.help: Instead of a fixed demand a range from the minimum to the maximum demand – the solver chooses the quantity within it.
field.useCapacities.help: from the edges of the network
field.useFixedCosts.help: from the edges of the network
field.maxSolvingTime.help: After this many seconds the solver stops and returns the best solution found so far – it may then not be optimal.
field.mipGap.help: The solver stops as soon as the solution can be worse than the optimum by at most this share – 0.001 = 0.1 %. Smaller: more exact, but longer.
field.capacity.help: Maximum quantity that may flow over the edge. Empty: unlimited.
field.capacity.help.multicommodity: Maximum quantity over the edge in capacity units: each unit of a commodity takes as much as its capacity factor. Empty: unlimited.
field.capacity.help.multimodal: Maximum quantity of this mode per edge. Empty: unlimited.
field.capacity.help.multistagewlp: Warehouse: the largest quantity it can pass on. Edge: the maximum quantity that may flow over it. Empty: unlimited.
field.capacity.help.routing: Largest load of a vehicle – in the unit of the demand or of the pickup amounts.
field.fixedCost.help: Costs as soon as anything flows over the edge – independent of the quantity. Empty: 0.
field.fixedCost.help.multimodal: Costs as soon as the mode is used on an edge – independent of the quantity. Empty: 0.
ui.problem.deleteText: Delete “{name}” with its settings and its solution from the file? Nodes and edges are kept.
ui.notYet: {type} is not implemented in the prototype yet
ui.node.placeHint: Click into the map to set the position
ui.col.name: Name
ui.net.help: With a network only its edges are allowed. Capacity and fixed costs are maintained per edge, length and travel time come from OSM.
ui.par.matrix: Matrix (applies to all problems of the scenario)
field.matrixSource.help: Road network: distances and travel times from the OSM servers. Beeline: the distance on the globe – fast and without a server.
field.travelmode.help: Profile of the OSM servers for distances and travel times.
field.costPerKm.help: Costs per km driven. Together with the costs per hour they give the costs of every connection.
field.costPerKm.help.multicommodity: Costs per km and unit of this commodity. Empty: the value of the matrix.
field.costPerKm.help.multimodal: Costs per km and unit with this mode. Empty: the value of the matrix.
field.detourFactor.help: Only as the crow flies: the distance is the great-circle distance times this factor, e.g. 1.3 for approximate road lengths. Empty: 1 (as the crow flies).
ui.legend.coverRoads: Radius as the crow flies – only a guide, the roads are used
field.costPerHour.help: Costs per hour of driving. Together with the costs per km they give the costs of every connection.
field.costPerHour.help.multicommodity: Costs per hour and unit of this commodity. Empty: the value of the matrix.
field.costPerHour.help.multimodal: Costs per hour and unit with this mode. Empty: the value of the matrix.
ui.sol.stale: The data has been changed after solving
hint.setMinRadius: Enter the smallest radius: {min} – then every customer is within the radius of a location
ui.check.radius: The radius is too small: at least {min}, else {customer} is outside the radius of all candidates
ui.check.openingCosts: The operating costs are to be considered, but all candidates have operating costs 0 – enter operating costs or switch off “Consider operating costs”
ui.copy.done: Copied to the clipboard: {n} rows – paste them into Excel
ui.import.helpNodes: Select cells in Excel, Numbers or LibreOffice, copy them and paste them here – with headers as when copying the nodes. Without coordinates they are looked up from the address.
ui.import.helpEdges: Select cells in Excel, Numbers or LibreOffice, copy them and paste them here – From and To with names or ids of the nodes.
ui.import.needsName: One column must be the name
ui.import.needsFromTo: Columns for From and To are missing
ui.import.notFound: {name} does not exist – choose “Add” to create it
ui.import.sameNode: From and To are the same node ({value})
ui.geo.noAddresses: No node of the list has an address
ui.geo.allText: The coordinates of {n} nodes of the list are looked up from their addresses and replace the current ones. This cannot be undone.
ui.backend.title: Computing
ui.backend.localHelp: Program of the solver (logisticsLabStdio) or Python with the module logisticsLabCore.stdio
ui.apiKey.title: API key
ui.apiKey.needed: The server needs an API key. You get it from your course or from whoever runs the server.
ui.apiKey.invalid: The server did not accept the API key – wrong, expired or disabled.
ui.backend.webOnlyRemote: In the browser problems are always solved on a server.
ui.split: Size of map and data area
ui.net.name: Name of the network
ui.net.exists: A network with this name exists already
ui.edge.drawStart: Click the start node of the edge
ui.edge.drawEnd: Click the end node of the edge
ui.edge.allHint: Creates the missing edges from every {from} to every {to}
ui.node.deleteRefs: Deleting the node removes these references.
ui.error.outdated: The solver is older than the app and does not know this function. Please update the solver (Settings → Computing) or reinstall the app.
ui.error.legacy: {file}: {ext} is a format of LogisticsLab 4 (or older) with planar coordinates and an own matrix. It cannot be converted into a scenario – only TPPX, TSPX, CLPX, DLPX, NWFX and VRPX.
ui.about.tagline: Optimisation of logistics problems on maps of OpenStreetMap
ui.about.thanks: Many thanks to Katrin Kampe for valuable suggestions and testing.
ui.about.successor: New development succeeding LogisticsLab 5 – its X files (TPPX, CLPX, …) can be imported.
module.mincostflow.description: Quantities through a network at minimal cost
module.maxflow.description: Largest quantity from a source to a sink
module.multicommodity.description: Several commodities share the capacities of the network
module.multimodal.description: Flow with a choice of the mode per edge
module.multistagewlp.description: Open warehouses in the network and distribute the quantities through them
field.minCap.help: At least this much must flow through the node. Empty: 0.
field.maxCap.help: At most this much may flow through the node. Empty: unlimited.
field.maxCap.help.multicommodity: At most this much may flow through the node – in capacity units (quantity × capacity factor). Empty: unlimited.
field.shortageCost.help: Costs per unit the customer does not receive – only with balance “automatic” when the supply is not enough. They decide where the gap remains: customers with high shortage costs are served first. Empty: 0.
field.minFlow.help: At least this much must flow over the edge. Empty: 0.
field.minFlow.help.multistagewlp: If the edge is used, at least this much flows over it. Empty: 0.
field.minFlow.help.multimodal: If the mode is used on an edge, it carries at least this much there. Empty: 0.
field.balance.help: automatic: unequal totals of supply and demand are balanced, what is missing costs the shortage costs. exact: the totals of supply and demand must be equal.
field.isInteger.help: Only whole quantities per commodity and edge. Without, the multi-commodity flow can give fractional quantities – integer takes longer.
field.supplies.help: Supply of the supplier per commodity. Empty: 0.
field.demands.help: Demand of the customer per commodity. Empty: 0.
field.capacityFactors.help: How much of the throughput of this node one unit of the commodity takes. Empty: the capacity factor of the commodity.
field.modes.help: Which modes may run on this edge. All selected: all modes of the scenario.
field.openingCost.help: Costs if this location is opened – independent of the quantity. Empty: 0.
field.name: Name
field.capacityFactor.help: How much capacity of edges and nodes one unit of this commodity takes, e.g. 2 for goods twice as bulky. Empty: 1.
field.isSingleSourceWlp: Each node served from exactly one warehouse
field.isSingleSourceWlp.help: Customers and warehouses of later stages receive their goods from exactly one warehouse.
ui.commodities.none: No commodities yet – create them in the parameters tab
ui.modes.none: No modes yet – create them in the parameters tab
ui.net.required: This problem needs a network – choose or create it in the network tab.
field.minBlock.help: Connections with a lower cost rate are blocked
field.maxBlock.help: Connections with a higher cost rate are blocked
field.price.help: Price the customer pays per unit – for maximising the contribution margin
field.unitCost.help: Production or purchase cost per unit at the supplier – for maximising the contribution margin
choice.endpoints.nodes: from one source to one sink
choice.endpoints.roles: from all suppliers to all customers
field.endpoints.help: With all suppliers and customers the core adds an artificial source and sink – supply and demand limit the quantity, empty: unlimited.
ui.edge.direction: This direction does not fit the problem – edges lead from suppliers over transshipment nodes to customers
ui.edge.allHintTransit: Adds the missing directed edges from every {from} to every transshipment node and from there to every {to}
module.tsp.description: Shortest round trip or passage through all active nodes
field.tourType.help: Round trip: back to the start. Passage: from the start to the end. With an open start or end the solver chooses the first or last node.
choice.tourType.round: Round trip – back to the start
choice.tourType.path: Passage – from the start to the end
choice.tourType.open: Open end – only the start is fixed
ui.net.directedDefault: Edges without their own direction are directed (from → to)
ui.edge.direction.label: Direction
module.shortestpath.description: Shortest path from a start to an end in the network
choice.tourType.openStart: Open start – only the end is fixed
choice.tourType.free: Completely open – start and end free
field.networkMode.help: Shortest paths: between two nodes the tour takes the shortest path through the network and may pass nodes more than once. Only direct edges: the tour reaches every node exactly once over an edge – a node with only one edge makes a round trip impossible.
choice.networkMode.edges: Only direct edges – every node once
ui.edge.allNodesHint: Connects all active nodes with each other – both directions in a directed network
ui.node.addHint: Click into the map – every click adds a node
ui.quit.title: Save the changes to “{file}”?
ui.quit.text: The scenario is not saved. Without saving the changes are lost.
ui.check.noNodes: No {role} in the problem – assign the role in the nodes tab
ui.check.multipleRoles: More than one role in the problem at: {nodes} – one role per problem
ui.check.noEdges: The network has no edges yet – create them in the network tab
ui.check.twoNodes: At least two active nodes are needed
ui.check.oneNeighbour: Only one edge at {nodes} – a tour over the direct edges visits every node once and cannot leave it the way it came. Choose the shortest paths under “Connections in the network”.
ui.check.costRates: Costs as the measure need costs per km or per hour – in the parameters tab under matrix
ui.check.zeroThroughput: Maximum throughput 0 at {nodes} – these nodes can neither send nor receive; leave it empty for no limit
ui.check.nodeParam: {field}: the node {node} does not exist or is inactive
ui.about.author: Author
ui.help.title: LogisticsLab Studio – Help
module.cpp.description: Shortest tour from the start over every edge of the network and back
module.vrp.description: Tours of the vehicles from the depot to the customers – with capacities and time windows
field.useTimeWindows.help: The time windows of the customers are kept. Without, only capacity, maximum duration and maximum distance count.
field.maxTime.help: Longest duration of a tour from the start to the return, including service and waiting times. Empty: no limit.
field.maxDist.help: Longest distance of a tour from the depot back to the depot. Empty: no limit.
field.serviceTime.help: Time the vehicle stays here, e.g. for loading and unloading. Empty: 0.
field.timeWindow.help: Earliest and latest start of the service as time of day. If the vehicle arrives earlier, it waits. “latest” empty: open.
field.count.help: How many vehicles of this type are available. Empty: as many as needed – the solver plans as few tours as possible.
ui.vehicles.none: No vehicles yet – create them in the parameters tab
ui.check.oneDepot: Only one depot is possible – several at: {nodes}
core.warning.maxflowFixedCosts: Maximum flow: the fixed costs are not considered
core.warning.maxWithoutPrices: Maximization without revenues (customers) and costs per unit (suppliers) – the contribution is only the negative transport costs
core.warning.maxWithoutCostRates: Maximization without costs per km and per hour – no transport costs
core.warning.capacitiesIgnored: The capacities are not considered because “Respect capacities” is off
core.warning.greatCircle: Continuous location problems use straight-line distances (great circle), not the road network
core.warning.networkIgnored: Vehicle routing uses the complete matrix of the OSM servers – the network is not considered
core.warning.notInNetwork: Maximum flow: not in the network, not considered: {nodes}
core.message.noStart: The solver process does not start
core.message.stopped: The solver process has stopped unexpectedly
core.message.timeLimit: Time limit exceeded – the problem has been stopped after {seconds} s
core.message.notPolled: Cancelled – the status has not been requested for more than {seconds} s
field.depotTime.help: From when the tours leave and by when they must be back (time of day) – also without “Observe time windows”.
field.fixedStart: All tours start at the start time of the depot
field.fixedStart.help: Otherwise each tour leaves as late as possible so that it does not have to wait.
module.pdp.description: Tours that pick up quantities or passengers and bring them to their destination – pickup before delivery, with capacities, time windows and a longest ride per passenger
field.amount.help: Quantity picked up here and brought to the delivery node
field.deliveryTo.help: Where the quantity is brought – a node with the role delivery
ui.check.deliveryTo: Delivery node without the role delivery at: {nodes}
field.delivered.help: Sum of the amounts brought here – entered at the pickups
field.stopTime.help: Fixed time per stop (stopping, parking, walking to the door) – once, even if several quantities are delivered here
field.serviceTimePerUnit.help: Time per unit delivered, e.g. per parcel or per person getting off
field.maxRideTime.help: Longest time in the vehicle from the departure at the pickup to the destination – empty: no limit (PDP), else dial-a-ride (DARP)
field.maxDetour.help: Ride at most this many times the direct ride, e.g. 1.5 – with a longest ride the stricter limit applies
module.wlp.description: Open warehouses among candidates and assign the customers – operating and transport costs as low as possible
module.pmedian.description: Choose p locations among candidates – sum of the distances to the customers as low as possible
module.pcentre.description: Choose p locations among candidates – the longest distance to a customer as short as possible
module.scp.description: As few (or cheap) locations as possible so that every customer is within a radius
module.mcp.description: Cover as much demand as possible within a radius for a budget
field.isCapacitated.help: The customers of a location together demand at most its capacity
field.isDemandWeighted.help: Distances times demand – large customers count more
field.radius.help: A customer is covered if an open location is at most this far away – in the unit of the measure
field.useOpeningCosts.help: With the operating costs of the candidates – without, only the number of locations counts
field.budget.help: The open locations cost at most this much together
field.maxLocations.help: How many candidates are opened at most
field.candidateSupply.help: How much the location can supply – applies with “Respect capacities”
module.contpmedian.description: p locations anywhere on the map – sum of the great-circle distances to the customers as low as possible
module.contpcentre.description: p locations anywhere on the map – the longest great-circle distance to a customer as short as possible
field.capacityPerLocation.help: One capacity for all locations found
field.isSingleSourceLocation: Every customer from exactly one location
field.isSingleSourceLocation.help: With capacities: every customer is supplied completely by one location, its demand is not split.
field.nrOfStarts.help: The method starts this often from other points and takes the best solution – more starts: better solution, longer computation
ui.sol.toSuppliersHint: The open locations get the role supplier – without a supply with the quantity assigned to them, e.g. for a transportation problem afterwards
ui.check.capacityPerLocation: Capacity per location too small: at least {min} for the total demand of {total}
ui.check.capacities: The capacities of the candidates ({sum}) are not enough for the total demand of {total}
ui.generator.title: Generate random problem
ui.generator.inSection: Only cities in the current map section
ui.generator.seed.help: The same start value and settings give exactly this problem again – e.g. one exercise per start value.
ui.generator.tooFew: {n} nodes, but only {cities} cities in the region – choose more countries or enlarge the map section
